flags.message: CourtListener MCP was rate-limited (HTTP 429, shared 1400/day quota exhausted, ~89 min to reset) on this cell's first and only attempted call (~18:00Z). The cell degraded gracefully per the prompt: predicted from the provisioned documents, the docket snapshot, the committed statpack, and corpus tooling. Cells later in a large fan-out day may routinely hit this quota.

documents.json lists one kind='brief-in-opposition' entry whose url field carries two pipe-joined URLs (the Jan 16 2026 BIO and the Jul 20 2026 merits brief of respondent) under entry_date 'Jul 20 2026', and the provisioned text file concatenates both filings. The content was usable — indeed valuable for a briefed-moment merits cell — but the kind/provenance labeling is misleading; petitioners' merits brief (May 22 2026) has no counterpart entry.
